subject: START statement
notes: NOW (kb/Work PB3334, INDEXED on the keyed store engine): the INDEXED organization moved to the keyed store engine (kb/Work PB3334; DESIGN-runtime-library 2.2.1.4): START LAST is the prime tree's last entry. kb/Work PB356 LANDED 2026-09-13. RULE: "If LAST is specified, the file position indicator is set to the value of the primary key of the last existing logical record in the physical file and the key of reference is set to the primary key. If no records exist in the file, the I-O status value in the file connector referenced by file-name-1 is set to '23', the invalid key condition exists, and the execution of the START statement is unsuccessful." (cite.py --check 14.9.41.4 "If LAST is specified, the file position indicator is set to the value of the primary key of the last existing logical record in the physical file" -> OK 14.9.41.4 19)). CODE: the same one method and the same one epilogue as GR18 - StartFirstLast searches IndexedConnector.SelectSequentialRecord(PrimeKey) and returns StartSucceeded(PrimeKey, seq[^1]); the last arm differs from the first only in which end of the prime-ordered sequence it takes, which is why a single method carries both rules and why the key of reference is passed as an argument rather than read from the connector. MEASURED before/after on the inverted-ordering file (01/CC, 02/BB, 03/BB, 04/AA) with the ALTERNATE established by a preceding START KEY IS EQUAL: START LAST + READ NEXT gave PRIME=01 (the alternate's last, CC), now gives PRIME=04, and the following READ NEXT is at end '10' - there is no record with a greater PRIME key. Under an alternate carrying SUPPRESS WHEN, LAST likewise used to be computed over a sequence IndexedConnector.SelectSequentialRecord had thinned; conformance:cases/14.9.41-START/pb356_start_first_last_suppressed pins it answering 03 - a record with no alternate access path at all (12.4.5.6.4 GR6). The empty-file half was already correct and is pinned by the EL arm of the 2002 golden (INVALID KEY + '23'). || EDITIONS AS ADJUDICATED: widened from 2014,2023 to 2002,2014,2023 on the same basis as GR18 - constructs.json start-first-last-2002 (introducedIn 2002, COBOL0900) and conformance:cases/_unassigned/pb352-start-sequential-first-below-2002 are the compiler's own dating of the phrase, and the 2002 golden exercises the rule there.
